entry.summary:
Dr Morgane Merien, entomologist and science communicator from the Canterbury Museum, talks about the mating habits of giraffe weevils.

Part of Our Insect Neighbours exhibition: A closer look at their hidden world: 21 March – 17 May 2026 Te Pito Huarewa Gallery, Tuakiri | Identity, Level 2, Tūranga Our Insect Neighbours is a collaborative exhibition, brought to you by Christchurch City Libraries and the Canterbury Museum.
